hints.title: Recursive Tree Stream Flattening
hints.text: Yielding elements from arbitrarily nested arrays sequentially emulates depth-first in-order leaf traversal.

hints.title: Delegating Yield with Recursion
hints.text: Loop through elements of the active array. If an element is another array, delegate control using yield*; if it is a primitive number, yield it directly.

hints.title: Generator Delegation Blueprint
hints.text: Define function* inorderTraversal(arr). For each item of arr: if Array.isArray(item) yield* inorderTraversal(item); else yield item.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total leaf numbers in array
complexity.notes: Each leaf number is yielded once with generator call stack bounded by nesting depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flattening the array upfront into memory with Array.flat(Infinity) creates unnecessary full copies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lazy yield* delegation consumes zero memory beyond the active traversal stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of yield* delegation for recursive sub-generator execution.

solutions.approach: Recursive Generator with Delegated Yield Star
